hypothesis: Two same-user negatives per positive may reduce the variance of the BPR objective estimate and improve within-user validation ranking at fixed model, features, seed, evaluator, and training budget.
failure_information_value: Failure would show that additional negative exposure alone is insufficient and would redirect the next mechanism toward listwise or strictly time-safe sequential interest rather than more BPR sampling.
next_action: B freezes one clean descendant of the gate merge and runs exactly one fresh full-budget valid-only baseline/candidate pair; E then independently audits and evaluates immutable predictions
